title_or_headline: MIT Vishwashanti Gurukul World School Tops EducationWorld India School Rankings 2025-26
summary_or_publisher_count: Ranked Maharashtra's No. 1 and India's No. 4 International Residential School
text_or_urls:
MIT Vishwashanti Gurukul World School (VGWS), a premier IB World School and leading boarding school in Pune, has achieved top honours in the EducationWorld India School Rankings 2025-26, being ranked No. 1 International Residential School in Maharashtra and No. 4 in India. This recognition from EducationWorld, described in the release as India's most comprehensive and credible school ranking survey, affirms VGWS's position among the best international residential schools in India.
